title: Product Showcase
objective: Build a responsive grid of product cards with consistent media, pricing and interaction states.

milestones.title: Product images with meaningful alt text
acceptance_criteria: Demonstrate product images with meaningful alt text in the project.
Keep the implementation responsive, semantic and maintainable.

milestones.title: Pricing, description and badges
acceptance_criteria: Demonstrate pricing, description and badges in the project.
Keep the implementation responsive, semantic and maintainable.

milestones.title: Consistent image crops and card dimensions
acceptance_criteria: Demonstrate consistent image crops and card dimensions in the project.
Keep the implementation responsive, semantic and maintainable.

milestones.title: Hover, focus and active states
acceptance_criteria: Demonstrate hover, focus and active states in the project.
Keep the implementation responsive, semantic and maintainable.

required_features: Product images with meaningful alt text
Consistent image crops and card dimensions
stretch_features: Add a documented theme variant or design token where appropriate.
Add a visual regression check for one representative state.
Document a trade-off or browser-support limitation.
tests: Build with the configured Vite/Tailwind workflow.
Inspect narrow, medium and wide viewport layouts.
Check keyboard navigation, focus indication, semantic roles and contrast.
Verify that required utility classes appear in generated CSS.
review_method: Static source checks plus human review; project code is not executed in the production FastAPI process.
status_note: Draft project outline; verify the implementation against the resolved dependencies before publication.
